docTitle: Mappui-a Bible · Bible Chanchin Thlûk Khat
metaDesc: Thuthlung Hlui hun kal, Isua nun, leh Paula khualzinte chu mappui dik takah zui rawh — Bible hi hmun dik takah a thleng a ni.

s.title: Mappui-a Bible
s.verse: “Kan Lalpa Isua Krista chu thiltihtheihna nên a lo kal leh tûr thu kan hrilh lai che u khân, thawnthu phuahchawp mai mai hrilh che u kan ni lo ve, a ropuina chu mit ngeia hmutute kan ni.” (2 Petera 1:16)
s.purpose: Bible hi hriatsualna a ni lo. Hmun dik, hun dik leh hming dik chunga lêng mite chanchin ziak a ni. Chûng kawngte chu mappui-ah, hun kalzêl dânin zui ang che — hmun pakhat khawih la, a nih loh leh ▶ hip la, pên khatin zui ang che.
s.ot_kick: ① Thuthlung Hlui — hun kal zêlin
s.ot_h: Siamtirna aṭanga Jerusalem-a haw leh thlengin
s.ot_lead: Zin khat chauh ni lovin, siamtirna aṭanga chhandamna chanchin luan zêl a ni: siamtirna leh tlûkna → tuilêt leh Babel → koh (Abrahama) → ram tiam → Aigupta chhuahsan → thlalêr → hneh → lalram → inthen → sâlna → haw leh.
s.je_lead: Chanchin Ṭha-in a sawi dân angin, Isua nun chu inzêlin zui ang che — Bethlehem-a a piannna aṭangin, a baptisma leh Galili rawngbâwlna kâlin, Samari kân chungin, Jerusalem-a krawsa, thawhlehna leh chunglam kalna thlengin.
s.pa_h: Antiok aṭanga lei tâwp thlengin — Rom
s.pa_lead: Jerusalem-a Pentikost aṭangin, Chanchin Ṭha chu Judai kâlkhawvêl a darh dân — Asia Minor leh Europe kâlin ram lianpui laipui thlengin. Khualzin panga (1-na·2-na·3-na + Rom pana zin + chhuah hnu) zînga pakhat thlang la, kawngkarah ziak lehkhate nên Tirhkohte thilthlengte zui ang che.
s.foot: Thu bul · Hmunte hi Bible thu leh Bible ram hriatna pângngai a zui a ni (a ṭangkai apiangin tûnlai hmingte nên). Tuipui kam, lui leh dîlte hi ram hriatna thu hawng (Natural Earth) aṭanga lâk, tihawlsam a ni.

eden.name: Eden (Siamtirna · Tlûkna)
eden.note: Khawvêl ‘ṭha êm êm’-a siam chungah sual a lût a, Pathian leh mihring inkârna a chat ta.

Mihring Pathian lim anga siam
Tlûkna, leh Eden aṭanga hnawt chhuah
Chanchin Ṭha thutiam hmasa ber — ‘hmeichhia thlah chuan rûl lu a vaw keh ang’

noah.name: Ararat (Tuilêt)
noah.today: tûnlai Ararat Tlâng, Turkey chhak lam
noah.note: Sualnaa khat khawvêl chu Pathianin a rorêl a, mahse chhûngkua pakhat zârin nunna a humhim.

babel.note: Vâna thleng tuma chapona chungah Pathianin an ṭawng leh mite chu khawvêl pumah a darhdar.

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Bible chhandamna chanchin chu mi pakhat koh aṭangin a ṭan.

‘Hnam ropui takah ka siam ang che… hnam tinrêng i zârah malsâwm an ni ang’
Rinna zârin a ram a chhuahsan

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: Kawngkarah, ram tiam panga koh chu a chhâng.
events: Tera chhûngkua chu Haranah an lo chêng
Tera a thi
Abrama chu kum 75-in Kanaan panin a chhuak

shechem.note: Ram tiamah chhûngkua a din a, thuthlung chu thlah tluangin a kal zêl.

Tuipui Sen a kâr a, an kân

kadesh.note: Rinlohnain chhuanlam pakhat chu ram a hloh tîr — mahse Pathian chu an bulah a la awm reng.

jericho.name: Jeriko
jericho.note: A tâwpah ram tiam chu an lût a, an luah ta.

shiloh.note: Lal an neih loh avângin, mi tinin ṭha an tih angin an ti — lal dik a ngai.

Sual–hnehchhiahna–chhandamna zinghlim (Debora, Gideona, Samsona)
Ruthi — hun thima rinawmna, Davida thlahah

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem · Ram Pumkhat
jerusalem.note: Israel hun rangkachak — leh lal chatuan thutiam.

Davida thuthlung — ‘i lalṭhutthlêng chatuanin’ (2 Sam 7)
Solomonan Jerusalem-ah Tempul a sa

Milem biakna a kâng vêl

Jona chu Nineve-ah a tîr a ni

babylon.name: Babulon
babylon.note: Zân thim ber — mahse tharsiamna thutiam chu a la awm reng.

Juda chu Babulonah hruai an ni

Estheran Judate chu tihboral aṭangin a chhanchhuak
Nehemia chu lal hmaah a ṭawngṭai a, a tîr a ni

return.name: Jerusalem-a Haw leh
return.note: An haw a, an sa that leh — mahse lal a la lo kal lo. Messia an nghah.

Tempul sa that a, Jerusalem kulhmang siam that

nazareth.name: Nazareth

events: Thing chhertu ina seilian

A hnuah a khaw synagog-ah hnâwl a ni

jordan.name: Jordan Lui

cana.name: Kana

jericho.name: Jeriko

seleucia.name: Selukia

salamis.note: Kupra-a ṭanna hmasa — synagog-ah thu hrilhin.
